title: Replacements, Lost Packages and Proof of Delivery on the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
Replacement and delivery rules of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, as applied by the fulfilment centres and the patient services desk.

## General terms of a replacement

A replacement ships at no charge, draws no authorized units and is never billed to a payer; it is recorded against the original shipment it replaces, and its quantity never exceeds the units of that original shipment that were lost, damaged, not received or defective.

## Replacement by cause

| Cause | When Larkfield replaces | How |
|---|---|---|
| Lost in transit: no proof of delivery is on file and the tier's carrier trace period (business days, Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays) has passed after the carrier's expected delivery date | Always | Expedited at no charge; it does not count toward any courtesy limit, because Larkfield bears the risk until delivery |
| Damaged in transit | When the customer reports the damage no later than the tier's damage report window (calendar days) after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that package, counted in calendar days from that delivery date with the last day allowed | A later damage report is not replaced |
| Shown delivered on the proof of delivery but reported not received | As a courtesy, only while the program's courtesy reships over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date are fewer than the tier's courtesy reships per 12 months | Beyond that the customer may buy the item at the cash price or wait for the next eligible refill |
| Defective as shipped: the wrong model, an expired or short-dated box, or a manufacturer-recalled lot | When reported no later than the tier's defect report window (calendar days) after the delivery date | Replaced as a product defect |

**Counting courtesy reships.** The count is the number of the program's replacement shipments made for a package delivered but not received whose ship date falls in the 365 calendar days ending on and including the reship date being considered.

## Items replaced by the manufacturer, not by Larkfield

- A sensor that fails, errors or falls off before the end of its wear period is replaced by its manufacturer directly, because Larkfield does not replace failed sensors itself: Larkfield ships no replacement for it, the failed sensor does not count against the allowance, and the customer is referred to the manufacturer's support line.
- A receiver or reader that fails within the manufacturer warranty (calendar months of its delivery date) is replaced by its manufacturer under warranty; after the warranty a covered replacement receiver ships only under the program's quantity rules.

## Proof of delivery

A proof of delivery is recorded as received from the carrier, with a signature where the tier or item requires a signature on delivery, and it fixes the delivery date that return, damage and warranty windows count from; a package without a proof of delivery has no delivery date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)

- **Damage window.** Suppose the window were 7 days and the proof of delivery showed delivery on 3 June. A damage report on 10 June, the seventh calendar day after delivery, is replaced; a report on 11 June is not.
- **Courtesy limit.** Suppose the limit were 1. A program with no courtesy reship in the 365 days ending on the reship date receives one; a program that already had one courtesy reship 200 days before the reship date does not, because its count of 1 is not fewer than 1.
